name: fno_coreg_conditioned
description: Single full-resolution HF FNO with FiLM-via-LayerNorm conditioning on the fidelity index m. Each FNO block applies GroupNorm followed by per-channel affine (γ(m), β(m)) produced by an MLP on [m, m^2]. The IFC outer-product basis is replaced by FiLM affines; m-modulation lives in the normalisation layer rather than a K-dim coregionalization head. Per-fidelity output scaler retained.
